project.name: MEMORA
project.productType: Privacy-first photo storytelling and living books

decisions: Implement the recovered premium editorial plan with warm paper and terracotta; one focal effect per section.
Refine the warm editorial identity with a contrasting charcoal story chapter, hinged book hero and physical paper turns; preserve keyboard operation, full text contrast and a manual motion pause.

User requested a distinctive scroll-responsive experience: burgundy book zoom and hinged opening, full-bleed memory match cut, then an interactive cream app. Native sticky geometry, reduced-motion natural flow, touch scrolling, and a direct skip are required.

Use self-hosted Newsreader headings and Plus Jakarta Sans body text, readable labels and 44px minimum phone controls. Phones use a compact hero with immediate Google sign-in, an optional sample, optional marketing chapters, and persistent Home / Memories / People / Book navigation; desktop keeps the cinematic scroll.
